The only way one could have obtained it is by having had a double spins ticket in one's inventory at the time the Squeal of Fortune was replaced; any unredeemed double spin tickets in the inventory then became double keys tokens.
On 7 January 2013, Jagex announced the upcoming release of chaotic claws, an upgrade to dragon claws available from the Dungeoneering skill.

The chaotic claws boast increased stats as level 80 weapons, and cost fewer Dungeoneering tokens to obtain than other chaotic weaponry; according to Jagex, this is because players must upgrade an existing pair of dragon claws to chaotic claws, a process that is permanent and renders the claws untradeable.
